description: Computes US take-home pay per pay period: federal withholding, Social Security, Medicare (+ Additional Medicare), state tax, and net pay, for salaried or hourly workers. Example: { payType: "salary", annualSalary: 80000, payFrequency: "biweekly", filingStatus: "single", stateCode: "TX" }. Estimate for guidance — 2026 rates from official sources (IRS/Tax Foundation/CRA/ATO/state revenue offices/HMRC).

annualSalary.description: Annual salary in USD (used when payType is "salary").

dependents.description: Number of dependents (informational, not withheld via CTC in this engine).

extraWithholding.description: Additional federal withholding requested PER PAY PERIOD (W-4 line 4c).

filingStatus.description: IRS filing status used for federal withholding.

hourlyRate.description: Hourly rate in USD (used when payType is "hourly").

hoursPerWeek.description: Hours worked per week (used when payType is "hourly", or to derive an hourly-equivalent when salaried).

payType.description: Whether pay is a fixed annual salary or an hourly rate.

preTaxHealth.description: Pre-tax health/HSA (section 125) contribution PER PAY PERIOD (reduces federal/state AND FICA taxable income).

preTaxRetirement.description: Pre-tax 401(k) contribution PER PAY PERIOD (reduces federal/state taxable income, not FICA).

stateCode.description: Optional two-letter state code to also withhold state tax. Omit to skip.

name: us_paycheck
title: US paycheck / take-home pay
